namespace FitnessBuddy.Zz.Tests;

public sealed class ZzCommentTests
{
    // [Trait("Req", "ZZ-080")]
    /// [Trait("Req", "ZZ-081")]
    /* [Trait("Req", "ZZ-082")] */
    /*
    [Fact, Trait("Req", "ZZ-083")]
    */
    [Fact]
    [Trait("Req", "ZZ-090")] // [Trait("Req", "ZZ-084")]
    public void Real_trait() { }

    // Comment markers inside strings are text: the trait after them counts.
    private const string Url = "https://example.com"; [Fact, Trait("Req", "ZZ-091")] public void A() { }
    private const string Open = "/*"; [Fact, Trait("Req", "ZZ-092")] public void B() { }
    private const string Path = @"C:\"; // [Trait("Req", "ZZ-085")]
    private const string Quoted = @"say ""//"" "; [Fact, Trait("Req", "ZZ-093")] public void C() { }
    private const char Quote = '"'; // [Trait("Req", "ZZ-086")]
    private const string OneQuote = @""""; // [Trait("Req", "ZZ-088")]
    private const string Raw = """a " // b"""; [Fact, Trait("Req", "ZZ-094")] public void D() { }
    private const string Both = $@"{Url}\"; // [Trait("Req", "ZZ-087")]

    /* C# block comments don't nest: /* */ [Fact, Trait("Req", "ZZ-095")] public void E() { }

    // covers: ZZ-096
}
